request.system:
Decide whether a sentence is fully supported by the quoted source texts and computed values given. Supported means
every claim in the sentence is stated in a quote or equals a provided computed value. Wording can differ; meaning
cannot. Anything extra, stronger, or interpretive is unsupported. Return only the tool call.
request.user:
SENTENCE: Diluted shares outstanding were 212,000,000 at 2026-06-30.
QUOTES: []
COMPUTED: ["m:diluted_shares:2026-06-30: {\"name\": \"diluted_shares\", \"period_end\": \"2026-06-30\", \"unit\": \"shares\", \"value\": \"212000000\"}"]

content.reason: The computed value m:diluted_shares:2026-06-30 gives value 212000000 shares at period_end 2026-06-30, which matches the sentence's claim of 212,000,000 diluted shares outstanding at 2026-06-30.
